manual_notes: Platform-neutral amount-display and recurrence implementations are present, but the specification requires directly importing useAmountDisplayPreference and useRecurrenceDetection. The shared files export createUseAmountDisplayPreference/createUseRecurrenceDetection factories instead; the named hooks exist only as their returned functions. The hooks barrel re-exports the factories without direct-hook aliases, leaving strict import-contract coverage unresolved.
